Let me break it down. First, why do people rinse vegetables? Well, it's mainly to remove dirt, pesticides, and bacteria. It makes the vegetables cleaner and safer to eat. I don't see any moral wrongdoing in either choice. It's more about practicality and personal preference. So, from a Christian perspective, I don't think it's a moral issue.
